subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 1×10=10 Once there was a clever fox in a jungle. One day when the fox walking through jungle, he fell into a trap. He could somehow get out of the trap, but he had to leave ...............
guide_solution: Story writing Once upon a time a greedy dog stole a peace of meat from a nearby house and holding it in his mouth he began to cross the river over a narrow bridge. When it reached the middle point of the bridge, it stopped there to take rest. After a while it was a dog with a piece of meat in its month in the river water the dog in the water looked just like itself. The dog was very greedy. So it wanted to have that piece of meat in the water also. So at one point it jumped into the water. As a result it also lost its own piece of math. Its was actually its affection in the water The greedy but foolish dog could not realize it.  Title : Look before you leap
